reason: A DSH compatibility layer for managing SillyTavern presets, character cards, world books, and user profiles, then binding them to sessions and assembling supported model context through a local UI.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 中导入、编辑和管理 SillyTavern 风格资源，并将其按会话绑定后组装为模型请求上下文。
summaries.en: A DSH compatibility layer for importing and managing SillyTavern-style resources, binding them to sessions, and assembling supported model request context.

capabilities: Imports, edits, exports, and stores SillyTavern-style presets, character cards, world books, and user profiles
Binds Tavern resources to DSH sessions and composes supported model request parameters
Applies per-session RP restrictions and records bounded resource and matching trace metadata
Provides a local web interface for resource management and session configuration
